_invariant: After playing all events through SubledgerPostingService, totalDebits must equal totalCredits and the snapshot files must match.
_distribution: 60 POLICY_APPROVED @ NGN 100k | 40 CLAIM_APPROVED @ NGN 50k | 40 CLAIM_SETTLED @ NGN 40k (20 paired to approved claims by claim_id, 20 standalone) | 20 ENDORSEMENT: 5 zero-net ADD/REFUND pairs @ NGN 20k on same policy (cancel at trial balance) + 5 standalone ADD @ NGN 20k + 5 standalone REFUND @ NGN 15k | 20 CLAIM_EXPENSE_APPROVED @ NGN 10k (each tied to one of the 40 approved claims) | 20 FAC_PREMIUM_CEDED (NGN 50k = 10k commission + 40k net)
_edgeCases: (a) zero-net endorsement pairs: 5 ADD + 5 REFUND at NGN 20k on policies 1-5 — at the policy level these cancel, but each one produces its own JE so the reconciliation gate sees 10 distinct entries. (b) claim approve-then-settle pairs: 20 claims (1-20) have BOTH a CLAIM_APPROVED and a CLAIM_SETTLED event in the fixture, exercising the dual flow through 5110→2140 (approval) and 2140→1120 (settlement) on the same claim_id. (c) claim expenses tied to approved claims: each of the 20 expense events references one of the 40 approved claims, exercising the claim → expense flow.
